headline: Tourism: credit extended to businesses grows (+7%), but sector risk remains high
summary: Credit extended to Italian tourism businesses grew 7% in the first months of 2026, as arrivals continued their growth trend. The report notes that sector risk remains high.
why: Lending to tourism firms reflects the health of a sector that is a significant part of Italy's economy and matters for bank loan books and credit quality.
